## Check metadata 

Adjust tissue area in T cell panel to the ones used in tumor and myeloid panel 

```{r}
sce_MY <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_MY_03.rds")

PID_area_MY <- colData(sce_MY) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(PID, tissue_area) %>% unique() %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(mean_tissue_area = mean(tissue_area))

summary(unique(sce$PID) %in% unique(sce_MY$PID)) #one PID - no tissue area info - TO DO: Re-do CP pipeline for T cell panel

sce$tissue_area <- PID_area_MY$mean_tissue_area[match(sce$PID, PID_area_MY$PID)] #Changes the tissue area of the original object
```

# 1. CD8+ T cells

```{r}
sce_8 <- sce[, sce$celltype_combined_broad %in% c("CD8")]
sce_8
```

## 1A: Differential expression

### Survival related 

#### Mean 

```{r}
# Aggregrate across cells with the mean
mean_sce_8 <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce_8, ids = sce_8$PID,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce_8)$CD8_cluster_channel)
```

```{r}
mean_exp_df <- assay(mean_sce_8, "min_max") %>% t() %>% as.data.frame

out_df <- data.frame(PID = unique(sce_8$PID))

for(i in colnames(mean_exp_df)){
mean_exp_new <- mean_exp_df %>% select(all_of(i)) %>% mutate(mean = mean(mean_exp_df[[i]])) %>% mutate(cat = ifelse(mean > mean_exp_df[[i]], "low", "high")) %>% rownames_to_column("PID")

out_df[,i] <- mean_exp_new$cat[match(out_df$PID, mean_exp_new$PID)]
}

## Add survival information 
out_df$status_OS <- sce_8$status_OS[match(out_df$PID, sce_8$PID)]
out_df$OS_months <- sce_8$OS_months[match(out_df$PID, sce_8$PID)]
```

```{r}
# Color for heatmaps 
colours <- c("#4575B4", "white", "#D73027")
breaks <- c(-2.5, 2.5, 0.5)
breaks <- seq(from = breaks[1], to = breaks[2], by = breaks[3])
pal <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(colours)(length(breaks))
col <- colorRamp2(breaks, pal)
```

```{r}
#Assess survival impact across categories
library(survival)
library(survminer)

colnames(out_df) <- gsub("-", "_", colnames(out_df)) 
colnames(out_df) <- gsub("/", "_", colnames(out_df)) 

# Extract p-values from log-rank / direction of trend
cur_surv_out <- foreach(x = colnames(out_df %>% select(-PID, -status_OS, -OS_months)), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ ", x))
  fit <- survdiff(formula, data = out_df)
  data.frame(group = x, p = fit$pvalue, obs_2 = fit$obs[1], exp_2 = fit$exp[1])
}

# Adjust p-values using BH 
cur_surv_out$p_adj <- p.adjust(cur_surv_out$p, method = "BH")

# Create and plot heatmap 
cur_surv_plot <- cur_surv_out %>% mutate(sign = p_adj < 0.05, direction = ifelse(obs_2 > exp_2, "high", "low"), type = "survival_prob") %>% mutate(p_out = ifelse(sign == TRUE & direction == "high",  -log10(p_adj), ifelse(sign == TRUE & direction == "low", log10(p_adj), 0))) %>% arrange(desc(p_out)) %>% filter(p_adj < 0.05)

cur_surv_plot_mean <- cur_surv_plot %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = type, names_from = group, values_from = p_out) %>% column_to_rownames("type")

Heatmap(cur_surv_plot_mean, col = col, border = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE, rect_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1), name = "log10(p)")
Heatmap(cur_surv_plot_mean, border = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE, rect_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1), name = "log10(p)")
```

```{r}
# Extract p-values from log-rank / direction of trend

  formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ ", x))
  fit <- survdiff(formula, data = out_df)

}

# Adjust p-values using BH
```

#### Extract survival relevant features

```{r}
markers_surv_relevant <- c(colnames(cur_surv_plot_median), colnames(cur_surv_plot_mean)) %>% unique()

# Extract min_max expression values
mean_exp_df <- assay(mean_sce_8, "min_max") %>% as.data.frame %>% filter(rownames(.) %in% markers_surv_relevant) %>% t() %>% as.data.frame %>% rownames_to_column("PID")

## Add survival information
CD8_key_features <- mean_exp_df
colnames(CD8_key_features) <- paste0("EXP_",colnames(CD8_key_features))
colnames(CD8_key_features)[1] <- "PID"

CD8_key_features$status_OS <- sce_8$status_OS[match(CD8_key_features$PID, sce_8$PID)]

CD8_key_features$OS_months <- sce_8$OS_months[match(CD8_key_features$PID, sce_8$PID)]

CD8_key_features <- CD8_key_features %>% select(PID, status_OS, OS_months, everything())

# Save
#write_csv(CD8_key_features, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/survival_pred/BlockForest/CD8_key_features.csv")
```


## 1B: Phenotypes - Univariate Cox

```{r}
### Mean / Median 
library(survival)
library(survminer)

PID_celltype_combined <- colData(sce_8) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(celltype_combined,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_celltype_combined <- PID_celltype_combined %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

### Multivariate cox proportional hazard model on multiple covariates (here proportion of phenotypes)
PID_metagroups <- PID_celltype_combined %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "celltype_combined",values_from = "fra") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

Cox_df <- PID_metagroups

colnames(Cox_df) <- gsub("-", "_", colnames(Cox_df)) 
colnames(Cox_df) <- gsub("/", "_", colnames(Cox_df)) 


## Based on categories (mean or median division of cluster proportions) 
Cox_df_mean <- foreach(i = colnames(Cox_df),.combine = "cbind")%do%{
Cox_df %>% select(all_of(i)) %>% mutate(mean = ifelse(Cox_df[,i] > mean(Cox_df[,i]),"B","A")) %>% pull(mean)
}

colnames(Cox_df_mean) <- colnames(Cox_df)
rownames(Cox_df_mean) <- rownames(Cox_df)

Cox_df_mean <- as.data.frame(Cox_df_mean)

## Add covariates 
Cox_df_mean$status_OS <- sce_8$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_8$PID)]
Cox_df_mean$OS_months <- sce_8$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_8$PID)]

#Cox_df_mean$gender <- as.factor(sce_8$gender[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_8$PID)])
#Cox_df_mean$age <- sce_8$age[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_8$PID)]
#Cox_df_mean$ISUP <- as.factor(sce_8$ISUP_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_8$PID)])
#Cox_df_mean$pT <- as.factor(sce_8$pT_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_8$PID)])
#Cox_df_mean$necrose <- as.factor(sce_8$necrose[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_8$PID)])

#Based on proportions
covariates <- Cox_df_mean %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months,) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df_mean)

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_mean <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],2),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],2),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],2),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],2),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],2))


#Plot hazard ratios
hr_mean <- ggplot(plot_df_mean, aes(x = reorder(group,dplyr::desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
#coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,20))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Immune metaclusters")+
ylab("HR for con_mean")+
theme_classic()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_mean
```

#### Density 

##### Mean 

```{r}
library(survival)
library(survminer)

PID_celltype_combined <- colData(sce_8) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(celltype_combined,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame

PID_area <- colData(sce_8) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(tissue_area,PID) %>% unique() %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(mean_tissue_area = mean(tissue_area))

PID_celltype_combined$mean_tissue_area <- PID_area$mean_tissue_area[match(PID_celltype_combined$PID, PID_area$PID)]
  
PID_celltype_combined <- PID_celltype_combined %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(density = Freq/(mean_tissue_area/1000000))  

### Multivariate cox proportional hazard model on multiple covariates (here density of phenotypes)
PID_metagroups <- PID_celltype_combined %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "celltype_combined",values_from = "density") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

PID_metagroups <- na.omit(PID_metagroups)

## 1. Based on continuous cluster proportions
Cox_df <- PID_metagroups

colnames(Cox_df) <- gsub("-", "_", colnames(Cox_df)) 
colnames(Cox_df) <- gsub("/", "_", colnames(Cox_df)) 

#add covariates for correction
Cox_df$status_OS <- sce_8$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce_8$PID)]
Cox_df$OS_months <- sce_8$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce_8$PID)]

#mean division 
Cox_df_mean <- foreach(i = Cox_df %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months) %>% colnames,.combine = "cbind")%do%{
Cox_df %>% select(i) %>% mutate(mean = ifelse(Cox_df[,i] > mean(Cox_df[,i]),"B","A")) %>% pull(mean)
}

colnames(Cox_df_mean) <- Cox_df %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months) %>% colnames
rownames(Cox_df_mean) <- Cox_df %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months) %>% rownames
Cox_df_mean <- as.data.frame(Cox_df_mean)

Cox_df_mean$status_OS <- sce_8$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_8$PID)]
Cox_df_mean$OS_months <- sce_8$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_8$PID)]

identical(rownames(Cox_df), rownames(Cox_df_mean))

#run the model
covariates <- Cox_df_mean %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df_mean)

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_dens_mean <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],3),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],3),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],3),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],3),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],3))

multi_res$coefficients

#Plot hazard ratios
hr_dens_mean <- ggplot(plot_df_dens_mean, aes(x = reorder(group,dplyr::desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Immune celltype_combineds")+
ylab("HR for mean_density")+
theme_classic()+
#coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0.01,10))+
scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10")+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_dens_mean
```

#### Extract survival relevant features

```{r}
MC_surv_relevant <- c(str_remove(plot_df_dens_median %>% filter(p_value < 0.05) %>% pull(group), "B"), str_remove(plot_df_dens_mean %>% filter(p_value < 0.05) %>% pull(group), "B")) %>% unique()
```

## 1A: Differential expression

### Survival related 

#### Mean 

```{r}
# Aggregrate across cells with the mean
mean_sce_4 <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce_4, ids = sce_4$PID,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce_4)$CD4_cluster_channel)
```

```{r}
mean_exp_df <- assay(mean_sce_4, "min_max") %>% t() %>% as.data.frame

out_df <- data.frame(PID = unique(sce_4$PID))

for(i in colnames(mean_exp_df)){
mean_exp_new <- mean_exp_df %>% select(all_of(i)) %>% mutate(mean = mean(mean_exp_df[[i]])) %>% mutate(cat = ifelse(mean > mean_exp_df[[i]], "low", "high")) %>% rownames_to_column("PID")

out_df[,i] <- mean_exp_new$cat[match(out_df$PID, mean_exp_new$PID)]
}

## Add survival information 
out_df$status_OS <- sce_4$status_OS[match(out_df$PID, sce_4$PID)]
out_df$OS_months <- sce_4$OS_months[match(out_df$PID, sce_4$PID)]
```

```{r}
# Color for heatmaps 
colours <- c("#4575B4", "white", "#D73027")
breaks <- c(-2.5, 2.5, 0.5)
breaks <- seq(from = breaks[1], to = breaks[2], by = breaks[3])
pal <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(colours)(length(breaks))
col <- colorRamp2(breaks, pal)
```

```{r}
#Assess survival impact across categories
library(survival)
library(survminer)

colnames(out_df) <- gsub("-", "_", colnames(out_df)) 
colnames(out_df) <- gsub("/", "_", colnames(out_df)) 

# Extract p-values from log-rank / direction of trend
cur_surv_out <- foreach(x = colnames(out_df %>% select(-PID, -status_OS, -OS_months)), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ ", x))
  fit <- survdiff(formula, data = out_df)
  data.frame(group = x, p = fit$pvalue, obs_2 = fit$obs[1], exp_2 = fit$exp[1])
}

# Adjust p-values using BH 
cur_surv_out$p_adj <- p.adjust(cur_surv_out$p, method = "BH")

# Create and plot heatmap 
cur_surv_plot <- cur_surv_out %>% mutate(sign = p_adj < 0.05, direction = ifelse(obs_2 > exp_2, "high", "low"), type = "survival_prob") %>% mutate(p_out = ifelse(sign == TRUE & direction == "high",  -log10(p_adj), ifelse(sign == TRUE & direction == "low", log10(p_adj), 0))) %>% arrange(desc(p_out)) %>% filter(p_adj < 0.05)

cur_surv_plot_mean <- cur_surv_plot %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = type, names_from = group, values_from = p_out) %>% column_to_rownames("type")

Heatmap(cur_surv_plot_mean, col = col, border = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE, rect_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1), name = "log10(p)")
Heatmap(cur_surv_plot_mean, border = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE, rect_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1), name = "log10(p)")
```

## 1B: Phenotypes - Univariate Cox

```{r}
### Mean / Median 
library(survival)
library(survminer)

PID_celltype_combined <- colData(sce_4) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(celltype_combined,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_celltype_combined <- PID_celltype_combined %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

### Multivariate cox proportional hazard model on multiple covariates (here proportion of phenotypes)
PID_metagroups <- PID_celltype_combined %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "celltype_combined",values_from = "fra") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

Cox_df <- PID_metagroups

colnames(Cox_df) <- gsub("-", "_", colnames(Cox_df)) 
colnames(Cox_df) <- gsub("/", "_", colnames(Cox_df)) 


## Based on categories (mean or median division of cluster proportions) 
Cox_df_mean <- foreach(i = colnames(Cox_df),.combine = "cbind")%do%{
Cox_df %>% select(all_of(i)) %>% mutate(mean = ifelse(Cox_df[,i] > mean(Cox_df[,i]),"B","A")) %>% pull(mean)
}

colnames(Cox_df_mean) <- colnames(Cox_df)
rownames(Cox_df_mean) <- rownames(Cox_df)

Cox_df_mean <- as.data.frame(Cox_df_mean)

## Add covariates 
Cox_df_mean$status_OS <- sce_4$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_4$PID)]
Cox_df_mean$OS_months <- sce_4$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_4$PID)]

#Cox_df_mean$gender <- as.factor(sce_4$gender[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_4$PID)])
#Cox_df_mean$age <- sce_4$age[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_4$PID)]
#Cox_df_mean$ISUP <- as.factor(sce_4$ISUP_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_4$PID)])
#Cox_df_mean$pT <- as.factor(sce_4$pT_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_4$PID)])
#Cox_df_mean$necrose <- as.factor(sce_4$necrose[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_4$PID)])

#Based on proportions
covariates <- Cox_df_mean %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months,) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df_mean)

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_mean <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],2),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],2),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],2),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],2),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],2))


#Plot hazard ratios
hr_mean <- ggplot(plot_df_mean, aes(x = reorder(group,dplyr::desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
#coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,20))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Immune metaclusters")+
ylab("HR for con_mean")+
theme_classic()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_mean
```

#### Density 

##### Mean 

```{r}
library(survival)
library(survminer)

PID_celltype_combined <- colData(sce_4) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(celltype_combined,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame

PID_area <- colData(sce_4) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(tissue_area,PID) %>% unique() %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(mean_tissue_area = mean(tissue_area))

PID_celltype_combined$mean_tissue_area <- PID_area$mean_tissue_area[match(PID_celltype_combined$PID, PID_area$PID)]
  
PID_celltype_combined <- PID_celltype_combined %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(density = Freq/(mean_tissue_area/1000000))  

### Multivariate cox proportional hazard model on multiple covariates (here density of phenotypes)
PID_metagroups <- PID_celltype_combined %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "celltype_combined",values_from = "density") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

PID_metagroups <- na.omit(PID_metagroups)

## 1. Based on continuous cluster proportions
Cox_df <- PID_metagroups

colnames(Cox_df) <- gsub("-", "_", colnames(Cox_df)) 
colnames(Cox_df) <- gsub("/", "_", colnames(Cox_df)) 

#add covariates for correction
Cox_df$status_OS <- sce_4$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce_4$PID)]
Cox_df$OS_months <- sce_4$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce_4$PID)]

#mean division 
Cox_df_mean <- foreach(i = Cox_df %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months) %>% colnames,.combine = "cbind")%do%{
Cox_df %>% select(i) %>% mutate(mean = ifelse(Cox_df[,i] > mean(Cox_df[,i]),"B","A")) %>% pull(mean)
}

colnames(Cox_df_mean) <- Cox_df %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months) %>% colnames
rownames(Cox_df_mean) <- Cox_df %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months) %>% rownames
Cox_df_mean <- as.data.frame(Cox_df_mean)

Cox_df_mean$status_OS <- sce_4$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_4$PID)]
Cox_df_mean$OS_months <- sce_4$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_4$PID)]

identical(rownames(Cox_df), rownames(Cox_df_mean))

#run the model
covariates <- Cox_df_mean %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df_mean)

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_dens_mean <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],3),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],3),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],3),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],3),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],3))

multi_res$coefficients

#Plot hazard ratios
hr_dens_mean <- ggplot(plot_df_dens_mean, aes(x = reorder(group,dplyr::desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Immune celltype_combineds")+
ylab("HR for mean_density")+
theme_classic()+
#coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0.01,10))+
scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10")+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_dens_mean
```

```{r}
sce_T
```

```{r}
### Mean / Median 
library(survival)
library(survminer)

PID_Tcell_district_names <- colData(sce_T) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(Tcell_district_names,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_Tcell_district_names <- PID_Tcell_district_names %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

### Multivariate cox proportional hazard model on multiple covariates (here proportion of phenotypes)
PID_metagroups <- PID_Tcell_district_names %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "Tcell_district_names",values_from = "fra") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

PID_metagroups <- na.omit(PID_metagroups)

Cox_df <- PID_metagroups

colnames(Cox_df) <- gsub("-", "_", colnames(Cox_df)) 
colnames(Cox_df) <- gsub("/", "_", colnames(Cox_df)) 


## Based on categories (mean or median division of cluster proportions) 
Cox_df_mean <- foreach(i = colnames(Cox_df),.combine = "cbind")%do%{
Cox_df %>% select(all_of(i)) %>% mutate(mean = ifelse(Cox_df[,i] > mean(Cox_df[,i]),"B","A")) %>% pull(mean)
}

colnames(Cox_df_mean) <- colnames(Cox_df)
rownames(Cox_df_mean) <- rownames(Cox_df)

Cox_df_mean <- as.data.frame(Cox_df_mean)

## Add covariates 
Cox_df_mean$status_OS <- sce_T$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_T$PID)]
Cox_df_mean$OS_months <- sce_T$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_T$PID)]

#Cox_df_mean$gender <- as.factor(sce_T$gender[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_T$PID)])
#Cox_df_mean$age <- sce_T$age[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_T$PID)]
#Cox_df_mean$ISUP <- as.factor(sce_T$ISUP_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_T$PID)])
#Cox_df_mean$pT <- as.factor(sce_T$pT_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_T$PID)])
#Cox_df_mean$necrose <- as.factor(sce_T$necrose[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_T$PID)])

#Based on proportions
covariates <- Cox_df_mean %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months,) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df_mean)

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_mean <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],2),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],2),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],2),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],2),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],2))


#Plot hazard ratios
hr_mean <- ggplot(plot_df_mean, aes(x = reorder(group,dplyr::desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
#coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,20))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Immune metaclusters")+
ylab("HR for con_mean")+
theme_classic()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_mean
```

#### Density 

##### Mean 

```{r}
library(survival)
library(survminer)

PID_Tcell_district_names <- colData(sce_T) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(Tcell_district_names,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame

PID_area <- colData(sce_T) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(tissue_area,PID) %>% unique() %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(mean_tissue_area = mean(tissue_area))

PID_Tcell_district_names$mean_tissue_area <- PID_area$mean_tissue_area[match(PID_Tcell_district_names$PID, PID_area$PID)]
  
PID_Tcell_district_names <- PID_Tcell_district_names %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(density = Freq/(mean_tissue_area/1000000))  

### Multivariate cox proportional hazard model on multiple covariates (here density of phenotypes)
PID_metagroups <- PID_Tcell_district_names %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "Tcell_district_names",values_from = "density") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

PID_metagroups <- na.omit(PID_metagroups)

## 1. Based on continuous cluster proportions
Cox_df <- PID_metagroups

colnames(Cox_df) <- gsub("-", "_", colnames(Cox_df)) 
colnames(Cox_df) <- gsub("/", "_", colnames(Cox_df)) 

#add covariates for correction
Cox_df$status_OS <- sce_T$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce_T$PID)]
Cox_df$OS_months <- sce_T$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce_T$PID)]

#mean division 
Cox_df_mean <- foreach(i = Cox_df %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months) %>% colnames,.combine = "cbind")%do%{
Cox_df %>% select(i) %>% mutate(mean = ifelse(Cox_df[,i] > mean(Cox_df[,i]),"B","A")) %>% pull(mean)
}

colnames(Cox_df_mean) <- Cox_df %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months) %>% colnames
rownames(Cox_df_mean) <- Cox_df %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months) %>% rownames
Cox_df_mean <- as.data.frame(Cox_df_mean)

Cox_df_mean$status_OS <- sce_T$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_T$PID)]
Cox_df_mean$OS_months <- sce_T$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_T$PID)]

identical(rownames(Cox_df), rownames(Cox_df_mean))

#run the model
covariates <- Cox_df_mean %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df_mean)

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_dens_mean <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],3),

                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],3),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],3),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],3))

multi_res$coefficients

#Plot hazard ratios

geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+

#coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0.01,10))+

theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_dens_mean
```

# 4. Interactions

## Differential interaction analysis

```{r}
### General phenotype interaction difference
library(spicyR)
library(lisaClust)

## ISUP 

set.seed(22)

# Generate segmentedCells object 
cur_sce <- sce

cells <- data.frame(row.names = colnames(cur_sce))
cells$x <- cur_sce$Pos_X
cells$y <- cur_sce$Pos_Y
cells$imageID <- cur_sce$sample_id
cells$imageCellID <- cur_sce$ObjectNumber
cells$cellType <- cur_sce$celltype_combined # adjust

cells_sc <- SegmentedCells(cells, cellProfiler = TRUE)

# Add condition and patient id
unique(cur_sce$ISUP_combined)

cat <- relevel(x=factor(cur_sce$ISUP_combined), ref = "1/2")

imagePheno(cells_sc) <- DataFrame(imageID = cur_sce$sample_id, # analogous to colData
          PID = cur_sce$PID,
          ISUP = cat
          )

cells_sc

# Run differential interaction analysis 
spicyTest <- spicy(cells_sc, 
      condition = "ISUP", 
      subject = "PID", 
      BPPARAM = BiocParallel::MulticoreParam())

saveRDS(spicyTest, "/mnt/central_nas_full/users/lasmey/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/T_panel/data_analysis/spicyTest_Tcell_ISUP_LM_combined.rds")

topPairs(spicyTest, cutoff = 0.05, n=40)

out_ISUP <- signifPlot(spicyTest,
                       fdr = TRUE,
                       marksToPlot = unique(sce$celltype_combined)) # adjust

out_ISUP
````

#### Survival testing 

##### Mean 
```{r}
# Extract spicy output from L function (mean difference across specific radi)
## This is the same for all different comparisons 
spicy_out <- spicyTest$df 

spicy_out <- as.data.frame(do.call("cbind",spicyTest$pairwiseAssoc))
rownames(spicy_out) <- spicyTest$imageIDs

## Different options for selecting interactions
# A: Only select interactions FROM tumor cells
#selected_pairs <- str_detect(str_split(colnames(spicy_out), "__", simplify = TRUE)[,1], "TU") & str_detect(str_split(colnames(spicy_out), "__", simplify = TRUE)[,2], "TU")
# B: Only select interactions FROM tumor cells TO non-tumor cells
# selected_pairs <- str_detect(str_split(colnames(spicy_out), "__", simplify = TRUE)[,1], "TU") &
#   (!str_detect(str_split(colnames(spicy_out), "__", simplify = TRUE)[,2], "TU")) & 
#   (!str_detect(colnames(spicy_out), "Unknown"))

selected_pairs <- (str_detect(str_split(colnames(spicy_out), "__", simplify = TRUE)[,1], "CD8") |
  (str_detect(str_split(colnames(spicy_out), "__", simplify = TRUE)[,1], "CD8"))) & (!str_detect(colnames(spicy_out), "Unknown"))
  # (str_detect(str_split(colnames(spicy_out), "__", simplify = TRUE)[,2], "CD4") |
  # (str_detect(str_split(colnames(spicy_out), "__", simplify = TRUE)[,2], "CD8"))) &
  # (!str_detect(colnames(spicy_out), "Unknown"))

spicy_out_selected <- spicy_out[,selected_pairs]

spicy_out_selected <- spicy_out_selected %>% rownames_to_column("sample_id")
spicy_out_selected$PID <- sce$PID[match(spicy_out_selected$sample_id, sce$sample_id)]

spicy_out_selected_long <- spicy_out_selected %>% pivot_longer(cols = 2:(ncol(spicy_out_selected)-1), names_to = "pair", values_to = "coef")

# Perform mean interaction score split for all categories 
out_df <- data.frame(PID = unique(sce$PID))

for(i in unique(spicy_out_selected_long$pair)){
spicy_out_loop <- spicy_out_selected_long %>% filter(pair == i) %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(mean_coef = mean(coef,na.rm = TRUE)) %>% select(PID, mean_coef) %>% unique()

spicy_out_loop <- spicy_out_loop %>% mutate(cat = ifelse(mean_coef < median(spicy_out_loop$mean_coef, na.rm = TRUE), "low", "high"))

out_df[,i] <- spicy_out_loop$cat[match(out_df$PID, spicy_out_loop$PID)]
}

# Filter columns with only one entry of high/low
include <- c("PID",out_df %>% pivot_longer(2:ncol(out_df), names_to = "int", values_to = "value") %>% group_by(int) %>% dplyr::count(value) %>% dplyr::count(value) %>% mutate(sum = sum(n)) %>% filter(sum > 2) %>% pull("int") %>% unique())
out_df <- out_df[, colnames(out_df) %in% include]

## Add survival information 
out_df$status_OS <- sce$status_OS[match(out_df$PID, sce$PID)]
out_df$OS_months <- sce$OS_months[match(out_df$PID, sce$PID)]

colnames(out_df) <- gsub("-", "_", colnames(out_df)) 
colnames(out_df) <- gsub("/", "_", colnames(out_df)) 

```



```{r}
# Color for heatmaps 
colours <- c("#4575B4", "white", "#D73027")
breaks <- c(-2, 2, 0.5)
breaks <- seq(from = breaks[1], to = breaks[2], by = breaks[3])
pal <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(colours)(length(breaks))
col <- colorRamp2(breaks, pal)
```

```{r}
#Assess survival impact across categories
library(survival)
library(survminer)

# Extract p-values from log-rank / direction of trend
cur_surv_out <- foreach(x = colnames(out_df %>% select(-PID, -status_OS, -OS_months)), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ ", x))
  fit <- survdiff(formula, data = out_df)
  data.frame(group = x, p = fit$pvalue, obs_2 = fit$obs[1], exp_2 = fit$exp[1])
}

# Adjust p-values using BH 
cur_surv_out$p_adj <- p.adjust(cur_surv_out$p, method = "BH")

# Create and plot heatmap 
cur_surv_plot <- cur_surv_out %>% 
  mutate(sign = ifelse(p_adj < 0.1, "sign", ifelse(p < 0.05, "sign_trend", "not_sig")), 
                        direction = ifelse(obs_2 > exp_2, "high", "low"), type = "survival_prob") %>% 
  mutate(p_out = ifelse(sign %in% c("sign", "sign_trend") & direction == "high",  -log10(p_adj), 
                        ifelse(sign %in% c("sign", "sign_trend") & direction == "low", log10(p_adj), 0))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(p_out)) %>% filter(sign %in% c("sign", "sign_trend"))

cur_surv_plot <- cur_surv_out %>% mutate(direction = ifelse(obs_2 > exp_2, "high", "low"), type = "survival_prob") %>% filter(p < 0.05)

cur_surv_plot$result <- ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "high" & cur_surv_plot$p_adj < 0.1, "UP",
                             ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "high" & cur_surv_plot$p < 0.05, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "low" & cur_surv_plot$p_adj < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "low" & cur_surv_plot$p < 0.05, "DOWN_trend",NA))))


# Add info on hetero or homotypic interaction
cur_surv_plot$int_type <- ifelse(str_count(cur_surv_plot$group, "CD8") > 1, "homotypic", "heterotypic")

library(ggnewscale)
ggplot(cur_surv_plot, aes(x=group, y = type, col = result, size = -log10(p), shape = int_type))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(18, 16))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```
